sides.name: Eastern Roman Empire (Valens)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Modern estimates 15,000 (Heather) to 30,000 (Williams and Friell); mid 20,000. Role split (legions/auxilia palatina, foot archers, scholae and mounted archers) is an educated guess. Command 0.35: attacked after an 8-mile march in heat, without waiting for Gratian, underestimating the Goths; cavalry attacked without orders. Training 0.75: comitatenses field army.

sides.name: Goths (Thervingi, Greuthungi) and Alans (Fritigern)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Total 12,000-15,000 (Delbrück) to 20,000 (Williams and Friell). Thervingi infantry defending the wagon laager on a hill; the Greuthungi and Alan cavalry under Alatheus and Saphrax were foraging and arrived early in the fight to strike the Roman left (reinforcement at day 0.05). Infantry/cavalry split is an educated guess. Tribal warband host mapped to archetype-feudal-host. Morale 0.85: existential, starving refugees. Wagon laager is a field fortification, not a fortified city, so fortified=false.

outcome.note: Gothic victory; Valens killed. Roman losses 10,000-15,000 (Heather) or 20,000 (Williams and Friell), about two thirds of the army (Ammianus). Gothic losses unknown: educated guess, grade D. Fight began in the afternoon and ended at nightfall.
